summary: Full backend + frontend validation of Free World token unlock/retry UX. Backend rules verified: early-unlock happy path deducts exactly 1 token (350->349), double-call idempotency (second returns 409 LEVEL_ALREADY_AVAILABLE, no extra charge), progression guard on L3 (409 PREVIOUS_LEVEL_NOT_COMPLETED), insufficient balance (400), and retry-reserve double-charge safety. Frontend verified end-to-end for player1: header chip shows 350 TOKENS, L2 shows early-unlock hint, L3 does not, modal renders correct natural time / cost / current / remaining / cancel / confirm, confirm calls backend once, sonner toast reads 'Level unlocked / 1 Tokens used * 349 remaining', chip updates to 349 and persists after /world refresh. Insufficient-balance modal for player_broke shows 'Not enough tokens' with Top Up Wallet button that navigates to /my-account/wallet, and NO confirm/charge button rendered. Found seed-script hygiene bug (fixed) and a minor UX bug where the page briefly navigates to /login after a successful unlock confirmation before settling back into an authenticated /world.

ui_bugs.issue: After a successful early unlock confirm, the app briefly navigates to /login (sonner 'Level unlocked' toast is shown on the login page) before user returns to /world on reload. Session is not fully lost (subsequent /world reload shows PROFILE + updated chip), but the intermediate redirect is a UX regression and can look like a forced logout. Likely due to attempting to open the Level 2 game immediately after unlock while the level state/lock_reason has not yet flipped in the local store.

action_items: Fix WorldCanvas.confirmEarlyUnlock post-success flow so user stays on /world (or opens Level 2 game) instead of briefly landing on /login. Reload/refresh world state via the pl-world-progress-refresh event before attempting to open the level game.

OPTIONAL: consider also clearing world_token_retry_daily/reservations wallet idempotency markers in seed_token_test_scenario.py if additional retry test isolation is needed (unlock side already fixed).
critical_code_review_comments: Seed script (backend/scripts/seed_token_test_scenario.py) was resetting only wallet.balance but leaving wallet.applied_tx_refs populated. Combined with deterministic reservation_id (WLU-<season>-<user>-C<stage>-L<level>), _apply_tx_idempotent replayed the previous debit and returned tokens_remaining unchanged, giving a false impression that unlock did not charge. FIX APPLIED: seed now resets applied_tx_refs=[], lifetime_spend=0, lifetime_tokens_spent=0 in set_wallet.
Consider surfacing a clearer intermediate loading state on the early-unlock modal instead of allowing the immediate navigation-to-login after confirm.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend token unlock/retry endpoints are correct and idempotent. The only outstanding item is the frontend post-confirm navigation flash to /login inside WorldCanvas.confirmEarlyUnlock. When retesting, re-run seed script; verify the confirm-success flow keeps the user authenticated on /world (or directly on the Level 2 gameplay screen) without any /login intermediate state.
rca of the issue: Initial pytest happy-path FAILURE was caused by seed hygiene, not backend logic. Deterministic reservation_id WLU-season-1-<user>-C1-L2 + persistent wallet.applied_tx_refs from prior test runs made _apply_tx_idempotent return idempotent_replay=true with tokens_remaining unchanged. Clearing applied_tx_refs and spend counters in set_wallet restores clean-slate behavior. Manual re-verification confirmed 350->349 debit and 409 LEVEL_ALREADY_AVAILABLE on second call.
